name: Henry Warfield
bio: a Representative from Maryland; born in Anne Arundel County, Md., September 14, 1774; completed preparatory studies; held several local offices; settled in Frederick, Md.; elected as a Federalist to the Sixteenth and to the succeeding Congress; elected as an Adams-Clay Federalist to the Eighteenth Congress (March 4, 1819-March 3, 1825); died in Frederick, Md., March 18, 1839; interment at Mount Olivet Cemetery, Frederick, Md.
